newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly higher, new hotelier gains [CORRECTED 14:37 GMT].
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly higher, new hotelier gains [CORRECTED 14:37 GMT].

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mostly higher on Tuesday with new gains among hoteliers.
* Of 11 active shares seven rose, two fell, one was flat and one traded for the first time.
* Volume higher at 15,013 shares, turnover higher at 14.9 million kuna. Exchange rate: 5.4458 kuna = $1.
* Biggest gainer was drug firm Pliva which gained 300 kuna to close at 12,700 on volume of 384 shares

(Corrects company that was the biggest gainer from tourist firm Suncani Hvar. Due to an error by the Zagreb stock exchange, the figures issued for Suncani Hvar were wrong. Suncani Hvar closed at 85 on volume of 171 shares, five up from Friday, not at 269 kuna on 2,571 shares as previously reported. Therefore it was not the biggest gainer).
* Biggest loser was cable producer Elka, closing at 270, down from 320 kuna on a meagre volume of 123 shares.

* The most actively traded was Zagrebacka Banka which remained flat at 1,010 kuna, with 8,396 shares sold.
